_about: Dungeons journal quests no rule in tools/lib/codex/journal.js can place (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, Dungeons): a quest whose giver, ender, area and objectives all lie outside its instance and whose dungeon part is an item made inside. One row per quest and instance: { quest, instance (Codex instance key), source (URL), note }. Loaded by loadJournalQuests; a row whose quest or instance the Codex lacks is a build warning.

quests.note: Shards of the Felvine (Rabine Saturna, Moonglade): Forever's quest data says Type: Dungeon, and its objective is to find the Felvine in Dire Maul, take a shard from it once Alzzin the Wildshaper falls and seal it in the Reliquary of Purity (checked 2026-10-15). QuestieDB files it under Moonglade and lists only the Sealed Reliquary of Purity, which no NPC drops.
